text: At its meeting on May 10, 2022, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR2.2 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 26, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: Toronto Parking Authority's operating profit for the first quarter of 2022 is $1.1 million: $0.7 million better than plan. Operating revenues missed plan by $(3.1) million, however are $8.7 million higher than 2021. Bike Share operating losses for the first quarter of the year are $(1.5) million, +$0.1 million favourable versus our plan. Operating and administration expenses were lower by $3.6 million compared to budget as spending was adjusted to meet the requirements of the business.
